pages.text: Search jungles first. The jungle profile rolls one patch attempt per four eligible chunks on average and needs no nearby water. Ordinary tall-crop biomes use a rarer, water-dependent profile.

pages.title: Identify & Replant
pages.text: Coca looks like a leafy sapling at first. It develops up to three stacked stalk sections. Break older stems for leaves and seeds, or buy seeds from a novice dealer. Plant in dirt, grass or farmland.

pages.title: Harvest
pages.text: Allow bright light and room for stalks to extend. A placed seed must start on soil. The stalk builds upper sections on its own. Keep seeds for replanting and bring the leaves to $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/coca)tea or drying$(/l).
